column1: # Our names for the stock functions Q2 Pod touches that Shanling leaves unnamed, at stock V1.36's addresses. docs/rebasing.md

column5: what
Tidal stream-URL thread: waits for the track flag, fetches playbackinfo for the song id, decodes the manifest, starts the player
Starts the firmware update from /mnt/mmc/update.tar and stores its result in the check-firmware state.
Window-to-foreground handler: if no timer id is stored under timer_idex (or it is -1), quits the dialog.
One-shot timer of the msginfo dialog: calls dialog_quit on the dialog and returns 7 (remove).
Removes the dialog's timer if one is stored and resets timer_idex to -1.
Stops the dialog's timer.
Swallows keys 0xab, 0xde and 0xdf; on Return (0xaa) runs a helper and quits the message dialog with 0xb.
On pointer up with the event y field above 0x32, stops the timer and quits the dialog with code 0xb.
Pauses the cover task (state 2) while a result list scrolls, so covers are not loaded mid-scroll.
Per-widget visitor run by the search dialog's init: names tabs, binds Return and tab clicks, sets the edit tip, makes list labels
Looks up scroll_view_track and walks its rows so the playing track is restyled.
500 ms timer: re-highlights the track list on the autochange/forcerefresh flags, and on cover-finished walks the current tab list (track or album) to fill covers; keeps repeating.
Destroys the rows (widget_destroy_children) of the scroll_view_track/artist/album/genre lists of every tab except the selected one.
Runs the name search for the current tab kind on the typed text and copies the hits into the search show list.
Genre result row click: parses the row index from the item name and opens localmusic/albuminfo_page with a genre context (0xff09) built from the search list entry.
Album result row click: parses the index, copies the search list into the show list, opens localmusic/albuminfo_page.
Artist result row click: parses the index, picks the artist from the search list and opens localmusic/artistinfo_page.
Creates a 50x70 image in a search row and sets the default song, artist, album or genre art by kind
Creates a 50x70 image child of a parent and sets it to the list_into image.
Toggles the search dialog between history/tip view and the result tabs, filling the search edit text
Track result row click: parses the index, checks the file exists (msg_notfile dialog if not), loads the song list and opens playing_page.
Rebuilds the search dialog's track result list: one row with art, title and artist per result
Track tab click: sets the tab to 0; if a gate byte is set, clears the other tabs and fills the track tab.
widget_foreach visitor on result rows: styles labeltrack/labelartist red when file_is_playing, white otherwise.
Click on the list_item_search widget: flips a flag byte and calls edit_set_focus on search_edit with 1 or 0.
Stops the dialog's 500 ms timer (reads timer_idex, removes the timer, stores -1).
Starts the dialog's 500 ms timer (0x49c728) if none is stored and keeps its id in the timer_idex prop.
Visitor over result rows: for rows in the nine-row window from the first visible one, builds the cover or image path and sets it.
On scroll end: computes the first visible row (offset / 78) of the current tab's list and restarts the cover task for it.
Rebuilds the search dialog's album result list: one row with cover and album name per result
Album tab click: sets the tab to 2; if a gate byte is set, clears the other tabs and fills the album tab.
Key-up handler: ignored with the backlight off; Return runs on_return_onclick, wheel keys are swallowed or passed by wheel mode, Centre dispatches a click to the focused widget.
Reads the saved search history file and builds the history rows in the search dialog
Clear-history button: zeroes the in-memory history, deletes /mnt/data/musichistory and refills the history tab.
Creates the scrolling name label of a search result row and sets its text
Rebuilds the search dialog's artist result list: one row with image and name per result
Artist tab click: sets the tab to 1; if a gate byte is set, clears the other tabs and fills the artist tab.
Rebuilds the search dialog's genre result list: one row with image and name per result
Genre tab click: sets the tab to 4; if a gate byte is set, clears the other tabs (index 3) and fills the genre tab.
Window-to-foreground handler: refills the current tab (track with the playing highlight, artist, album or genre), then starts the 500 ms timer.
Writes the 2560-byte search history table to /mnt/data/musichistory.
History row click: a pointer x below 285 reads label_record_N, closes the kb_default_t26 keyboard and reruns the text as a track search; otherwise deletes entry N, saves the file and refills.
Takes the search_edit text, moves it to the top of the 10-entry history (dedup), saves the history, shows the tip and fills the track tab.
Input-method action (OK) handler of search_edit: runs the query (0x49fd00) when a check on the edit passes.
Sets the sort-changed flag and closes the sort-select menu.
Sort dialog row click: stores and saves the row's choice (a playlist's, class 0xff13, in g_playlistsort_flag; otherwise the list's sort from sortPlaylistMenu's neighbour table) and moves the tick.
widget_foreach visitor: binds a click on img_return to sortselect_dialog_close, and gives scrlabel_title the title_sort text and the s_scrlabel_white24l style.
On Return (0xaa) closes the sort-select menu through sortselect_dialog_close and returns 0xb; other keys return 0.
Quick settings' lock tile click: locks the keys.
Pointer-release handler of the quick settings dropdown: in drop states 1 or 2 with no timer yet, adds the slide timer
Timer of the quick settings dropdown: moves the dialog 80 px per tick to open or close it, then ends
Pointer-move handler of the quick settings dropdown: sets slide direction and drags the dialog with the finger
Window event handler that calls toolsStopUpdateMusic.
Return and Cancel handler of the library-scan dialog: stops the scan while the done counter is under 3, else quits the dialog.
Removes the dialog timer stored under timer_idex and resets the id.
Refreshes the dialog: sets label_msg (scan_updating or scan_updatefinish) and label_scanfolder, with the music count, and notifies the scan state.
Starts the dialog 200 ms refresh timer (updatemusic_dialog_on_timer) if no id is stored under timer_idex.
Window event handler that calls the timer-start helper.
Key-up handler: with the backlight on, Return or Centre stops the scan; wheel keys are swallowed.
widget_foreach visitor: for the widget named btn_no, sets its translated text to msg_no and binds a click to updatemusic_dialog_on_stop.
Timer of the folder-scan dialog: refreshes progress, and after the scan counter passes 2 stops the animation and quits
Removes the dialog's auto-close timer stored under widget property timer_idex and resets the stored id to -1.
Dialog window event handler that just calls the timer-stop helper.
Moves label_vol beside the slider handle and prints the current g_volume into it.
Looks up slider_vol and sets its value to the current volume.
100 ms timer: counts ticks, clears the volume-setting flag and resyncs the slider, closes the window at 31 ticks (about 3 s), returns 8 (repeat) or 7 (remove).
Starts the auto-close timer if none is stored under timer_idex, saving its id.
Dialog window event handler that calls the timer-start helper.
Restarts the idle count: if the timer is running only zeroes its tick byte, otherwise stops any stale id and starts the timer.
Slider value changing: reads the slider value, clamps to the max volume, stores g_volume, applies and saves it, resyncs the slider and restarts the idle timer.
widget_foreach visitor: binds slider_vol events (0x11f label follow, 0xf change) and disables label_vol.
Key-up handler of the volume dialog: wheel ticks step the volume (limit 100, max volume) and save it, Return closes
Album page scroll handler: sets the album-cover worker's task state to 2 (paused) if it is not already.
Wheel with nothing focused: finds the table's first visible row from yoffset (row 160 grid, 78 list) and focuses it.
widget_foreach visitor: sets the focus state on the row (or grid cell) whose index matches the one passed in.
Returns the album index of the focused row or grid cell (row*3 + cell digit in grid mode), or -1 if none.
Album page background handler: removes the page timer stored in the timer_idex prop and resets it to -1.
Rebuilds the album page navbar: back, home, now-playing gif, list/grid switch, and the multi-select buttons (all, add, fav, delete, cancel), binding their clicks.
Looks up 'table_client' in the page and calls table_client_reload on it.
Toggles select-all: flips g_allselect_flag, updates the batch selection and the all-choice image, reloads the table.
500 ms page timer: when the autochange, force-refresh or cover-finished flag is set, clears them, reloads the table and refreshes the navbar play gif.
Rebuilds the album table: clears rows, row height 78 (list) or 160 (3-wide grid), binds row callbacks, sets row count, starts cover task.
Navbar click: flips list/grid mode, changes the switch button style, resets the cached focus and yoffset, reloads the table and clamps the scroll.
Grid cell 3 click (album index row*3+2): in multi-select toggles the tick, otherwise opens the album.
Grid cell 2 click (album index row*3+1): in multi-select toggles the tick, otherwise opens the album.
Grid cell 1 click (album index row*3): in multi-select toggles the tick, otherwise opens the album.
List-mode row click (album index = row): in multi-select toggles the tick, otherwise opens the album.
Shows the mulselect/unselect tick image of a row cell by whether its album is in the batch selection, only in multi-select mode.
Fills a row cell's name and artist labels from the show-list entry: name falls back to another field when empty, artist to player_unknown; 24 px name and 16 px artist styles.
Sets one album row's cover image: md5 of the album name, picks .sldp small or large jpg if cached, else the default album image.
Shows or hides a row cell's playing gif and background if that album is playing.
Table on_load_data: for each row up to the list size, fills tick, text, playing mark and cover of its cell(s).
If the page has no live 'timer_idex' timer, adds a 500 ms widget timer (4a4400) and stores its id.
Album page return handler: reloads or keeps the list, refreshes row count and cover tasks, then re-requests covers.
On a widget whose name starts with t, registers handlers for events 0x14e and 0x14f (scroll end).
Album table scroll-end: frees images when memory is low, and if the first visible row changed, restarts the cover task from there.
Grid-mode wheel step: moves focus to the next or previous album (wraps), scrolls to keep its 160 px grid row visible, records it and runs the scroll-end handler.
Album page key-up: ignored while g_backlight_status is 0; Return goes back (on_return_onclick); wheel moves focus; Centre opens the focused album. Wheel and Centre ignored when g_wheelmode is 1.
widget_foreach visitor for focus_first_visible: among visible rows it keeps the smallest row index at or after floor(yoffset/row height) in the out slot.
Opens dialog/msginfo_dialog for 2 s with the msg_addfailed text.
Navbar Add click: with albums selected opens localmusic/playlist_page, otherwise shows the add-failed message.
Navbar Delete click: confirms with a dialog, deletes selected albums and shows a result message.
Navbar Add to favourites click: adds selected albums (event 0xf00a) and shows a message, or the add-failed message when none.
Navbar multi-select click: enters select mode (navbar_status 1), rebuilds the navbar and reloads the table.
Navbar Cancel click: leaves multi-select mode, clears selection, rebuilds the navbar and reloads the table.
Table on_create_row: binds the click handlers by child name (btn_table_row in list mode; btn_tablerow1..3 in grid mode).
Builds the album table's row widgets: list rows (365x78, cover, name, artist) or grid rows of three 110x160 cover cells.
Album page background handler: removes the page timer stored in the timer_idex prop and resets it to -1.
Looks up scroll_view on the album page and runs the playing-colour visitor (4a77a4) over its rows.
Visitor on an album song row's labeltrack/labelartist: picks the red style when file_is_playing, else white (24 or 16 px), and applies it if it changed.
All-choice button of the album navbar: toggles the all-select flag and every row's select box in scroll_view.
Click on an album song row: in multi-select mode toggles the tick, otherwise loads the list and starts that track
Builds one song row of the album page: button, selection image, title and artist labels, playing colour, click binding
Rebuilds the album page: navbar (back, home, play all, multi-select, now-playing gif) and the song rows
Adds the 500 ms album page timer once, storing its id in the timer_idex prop.
Album page foreground (0x12b): clears select flags, reloads the song list, rebuilds the view (restoring scroll offset after a delete or class change), refreshes play gif and colours, restarts timer.
Loads the album page's big cover from the .sldp cache by md5 of the album, falling back to default_album_big
500 ms album page timer: when flags are set, clears them and refreshes the playing colours, and reloads the big cover when asked.
Shows the msg_addfailed message through dialog/msginfo_dialog (2000 ms).
Add button of the album navbar: opens localmusic/playlist_page with g_class_type ORed with 0x10000, or the add-failed toast when nothing is selected.
Delete button of the album navbar: confirm dialog (msg_delsong), deletes the selected songs and toasts success or failure.
Add-to-favourites button of the album navbar: adds the selection and toasts msg_addfavsuccess, or the add-failed toast when nothing is selected.
Album page play: loads the album's song list from the show list, starts the first playable track or shows a not-found message
New in V1.36. Album page Play: returns without playing when check_forbid_play_no_headset(0) refuses, else runs localmusic_albuminfo_play_all.
Multi-select button of the album navbar: enters select mode, inits the select record, shows scroll_view's select boxes, reloads the class list, rebuilds the view.
Cancel button of the album navbar: leaves select mode, clears the record, hides select boxes, reloads the list, rebuilds the view and playing colours.
Sets the album cover worker task state to 2 (paused) unless it already is.
Rebuilds the Songs page's navbar and action bar children: label, play-all and order images, back, home, multi-select
Songs page's order image click: opens dialog/sortselect_dialog for the page's class (0xf001, and a playlist's 0xff13 since V1.36).
Sets up the Songs page's table view: create/prepare/load callbacks, row count, scrollbar, navbar and empty hint
Click on a Songs table row: in multi-select mode toggles the tick, otherwise loads the list and starts that song
Fills one Songs row from its record: title, artist ('Unknown Artist' when empty), art, playing colours
Songs page return handler: reloads the list (0x4a969c) or keeps it (0x4a9744), then rebuilds cover tasks.
Frees image memory when low, and when the scroll offset moves to a new row (offset/78) starts the cover task for the visible rows
Plays the first song of the show list: loads the list, starts the player, or shows a not-found message.
Creates the Songs table's native row pool: list items with image, name and artist labels
Sets the album cover worker task state to 2 (paused) unless it already is.
widget_foreach visitor of the artist page: by name sets btn_track/btn_album text, focus and click (tab switch), and hooks scroll events 0x14e/0x14f on the scroll views.
Rebuilds a Local Music tab's navbar (back, home, multi-select, now-playing gif) for the artist and similar pages
Visitor over the artist Tracks tab rows: for rows in the visible window builds the cover's md5 path from the song record, checks the cache and sets the row image or default.
Artist albums list handler: finds visible rows from the scroll position and builds each row's cover name and path for the cover queue.
Delete button of a Local Music tab navbar: confirm dialog (msg_delalbum/msg_delsong), deletes the selection, toasts success, failure or unsupported.
Add-to-favourites button of a Local Music tab navbar: adds the selected albums or songs and toasts msg_addfavsuccess, or msg_addfailed when nothing is selected.
Click on an artist-page album tile: in multi-select toggles the tile's img_choice mark (mulselect/unselect), otherwise opens localmusic/albuminfo_page for that album.
Fills the artist page Albums tab: a three-tile grid of album covers, names and playing marks per row.
Runs the artist page's Albums tab click: sets the view flag and calls the tab helper.
If the focused widget's name starts with track_ or album_, copies that name into a global buffer (tk_snprintf) so the focus can be restored.
Artist page handler bound to event 0x12c: frees the song info with toolsFreeStSongInfo and clears the g_songerinfo_flag.
Artist page background handler: removes the page timer stored in the timer_idex prop and resets it to -1.
Visitor over artist Tracks rows: names labeltrack/labelartist red when the row's song is playing else white, sets img_pic, and shows the playing gif.
Visitor over artist Albums tiles: when playing and the album is current, shows the imggifbg/playing_gif_big tile and plays the gif, else hides it.
Click handler for an artist-page track row: looks up the song and plays it (or marks it in select mode).
Fills the artist page Songs tab: one row per track with number, title, artist, playing gif and select mark.
Artist page's btn_track click: sets the tab flag to 0 (Tracks), resets state and calls localmusic_artistinfo_songs_fill.
Adds the 500 ms page timer once, storing its id in the timer_idex prop.
For the current artist tab looks up scroll_view_album or scroll_view_track and runs the cover visitor (albums_on_scroll_end or 4ad574) over its rows.
For the current artist tab runs the playing-mark visitor (4af248 for albums, 4aed4c for tracks) over scroll_view_album or scroll_view_track.
500 ms artist page timer: when the playing-mark or cover flags are set, clears them and refreshes the playing marks and the covers.
Artist page handler bound by its page init: clears multi-select, reloads the artist list only after a delete or a class change, refreshes tabs.
Timer tick: frees images on low memory, then asks the cover worker for the rows now in view when the scroll offset changed.
Multi-select button (s_img_mulsel) of a tab navbar: turns multi-select on, shows the scroll view's select boxes and rebuilds the navbar.
Cancel button (s_btn_cancel_navbar) of a tab navbar: leaves multi-select, hides the select boxes, rebuilds the navbar and refreshes covers.
Shows the msg_addfailed message through dialog/msginfo_dialog (2000 ms).
Add button of a tab navbar: with a selection opens localmusic/playlist_page with 0x1f001 (Tracks tab) or 0x1ff01 (Albums tab); with nothing selected shows the msg_addfailed toast.
All-choice button of a tab navbar: toggles the all-select flag and every row's select box in scroll_view_album or scroll_view_track.
Artist page key-up (0x114): ignored while backlight status is 0; Return goes back; wheel moves focus and refreshes covers; Centre clicks the focused widget. Wheel and Centre ignored in wheel mode.
Sets the album cover worker task state to 2 (paused) unless it already is; bound to the class table's scroll (0x14e) so covers wait while scrolling.
Returns the row index (field +0x78 of the table row) of the window's focused widget, or -1 when nothing is focused or it is not in a row.
Page handler for window to background: removes the page timer whose id is in the timer_idex prop and resets the prop to -1.
Rebuilds the class page navbar: title, return, artist/album switch (Artists only), edit, home, back-to-playing; in select mode select-all, add, favourite, delete and cancel.
Click on btn_artistswitch: flips artist_type (artist or album artist), swaps the button style, sets a refresh flag and toasts which mode is on.
Sets up the class list's table (table_view, table_client: rows, the create, prepare and load callbacks) and starts its covers.
Table prepare callback: binds the row click handler (0x10c) on the new row widget.
Row click: in select mode toggles the row mark; else Artists opens artistinfo_page, class 0xf006 allmusic_page, others load the songs and open playing_page (msg_notfile if missing).
Sets a category row's picture: the head for Artists, a genre icon, else the .downpic art.
Row bind helper for classes 0xf004/0xf006: sets the scrlabel_name text from the current deque item, its scroll speed and the white 24 px style.
Row bind helper for the other classes: sets labeltrackname and labeltrackartist, red style when file_is_playing, player_unknown text when the artist is empty.
Adds the 500 ms page timer once, storing its id in the timer_idex prop; callback 4b2ed8.
Works out the first visible row from the scroll offset (divisor 0x78) and queues covers when it changes.
Key-up handler: Return goes back; wheel keys move the focus within table_client (first visible row if none) and queue covers; Centre clicks the focused row.
Scrolls table_client to the stored yoffset prop (clamped to the maximum) and re-focuses the remembered row (index*0x4e) when it is in view.
Remembers the focused row's index, reloads table_client and restores its scroll offset and focus.
Click on the select-all image: toggles g_allselect_flag, sets the all-choice image, marks or clears every item and reloads the table.
The page's 500 ms timer: when a refresh, auto-change or cover-finish flag is set, clears them, reloads the table and refreshes the navbar play gif; keeps repeating.
Page handler for window to foreground: clears select mode, reloads the class list and table (or just restores the scroll), rebuilds the navbar, shows the play gif, starts the timer.
Shows the msg_addfailed message through msginfo_dialog (2 s).
Add button: opens localmusic/playlist_page for the marked items (class|0x10000), or shows the add-failed message when the selection record is empty.
Delete button: if items are marked, confirms with a class-specific message (Artists, class 0xf006, songs), deletes them and toasts the result; with none marked toasts a failure text.
Favourite button: adds the marked items to class 0xf00a and toasts msg_addfavsuccess, or shows the add-failed message when none are marked.
Edit button: enters select mode (g_navbar_status 1), clears the all-select flag, rebuilds the navbar and reloads the table.
Cancel button: leaves select mode, clears the all-select flag and the selection record, rebuilds the navbar and reloads the table.
Binds one Artists/Composers/Genres row: select mark, class icon, name and playing gif for the current deque item.
Builds a batch of empty Artists/Composers/Genres rows: select image, icon, name label and playing gif.
Page handler for window to background: removes the page timer recorded in the timer_idex prop and resets it to -1.
Rebuilds the Playlists navbar: return, add, edit, home and back-to-playing, or select-all, delete and done in select mode.
Edit button: enters multi-select mode, rebuilds the navbar and shows the row select boxes.
Add button: opens the add-playlist dialog unless the add state is already set.
Done button: leaves multi-select, clears selections, hides the select boxes and rebuilds the navbar.
Select All button: toggles the all-select flag, the all-choice image and every row's select box.
Adds the marked songs to the chosen playlist (batch_add_file, class 0xf00b) and sets g_addplaylist_state to 2; started from the playlist row click, not called directly.
Shows or hides the image_wait widget and plays or pauses its animation.
Click on a playlist row: plays or opens it, toggles its mark in select mode, or runs the picker flow.
The page's 500 ms timer: below state 1 it clears refresh flags and refreshes the play gif; at state 2 it toasts the add-success message, hides the wait image and ends the job.
Adds the 500 ms page timer once, storing its id in the timer_idex prop; callback 4b4c0c.
widget_foreach visitor: binds a 0x10c click handler to the child named img_return, and applies a style to the child named scrlabel_title.
Builds Playlists rows: cover, name, track count line and the More dots, one per deque item.
Rebuilds the Playlists page's rows: import, export, then one per playlist; run by its init and its reload.
Page handler: resets select flags, rebuilds the playlist rows and restores the scroll offset.
Delete button: confirms with a dialog, deletes the selected playlists and toasts success or failure.
Export button: confirms, exports the playlists and toasts a result message.
Import button: confirms, imports playlists, sets a reload flag and toasts a result message.
Remove from Playlist: confirms, deletes the song from the playlist and closes the page.
Saves the boot volume to PLAYSET BOOTVOLUME when the slider value has changed.
Raises the boot volume by one up to 100, saves it and refreshes the page.
Lowers the boot volume by one down to 0, saves it and refreshes the page.
Takes the slider value while it drags, if at most 100, and refreshes the page.
Page handler for window to background: removes the page timer kept in the timer_idex prop.
500 ms page timer: when the force-refresh or auto-change flag is set, clears both and refreshes the navbar play gif.
Playback settings row click: switches on the row index to open a sub-page or toggle gapless, cover mode, folder cover or folder jump.
Adds the 500 ms page timer once, storing its id in the timer_idex prop; callback 4bce1c.
Page handler for window to foreground: refreshes the navbar play gif, then starts the page timer.
Fills the EQ preset page's image%d and label%d rows with the preset names, the chosen one red, and sizes list_view for the navigation bar.
Page handler for window to background: removes the page timer kept in the timer_idex prop.
500 ms page timer: when the force-refresh or auto-change flag is set, clears both and refreshes the navbar play gif.
New in V1.36. Builds Volume and Album Display's four rows (ids 4, 5, 13, 14: Max Volume, Default Volume, Enlarged Album Art, Folder Album Cover).
Adds the 500 ms page timer once, storing its id in the timer_idex prop; callback 4bff7c.
Page handler for window to foreground: refreshes the navbar play gif, then starts the page timer.
New in V1.36. Volume and Album Display row click: opens maxvol_page or bootvol_page, or flips g_bigcovermode / g_foldercover_flag and saves PLAYSET COVERMODE / FOLDERCOVER.
Builds one About page row (Model, Firmware and the others) with title and value label and binds its click.
About row click: on row 6 rebuilds the serial-number QR image and opens the showsn dialog.
Builds row i of the automatic time page: the switch at 0, a time zone with its tick after it.
Rebuilds the auto-time page list: the auto-sync row, then a caption and one timezone row per zone when auto sync is on.
Row click: row 0 toggles auto time sync, any other row picks that timezone, updates the marks and saves it.
Builds a paired Bluetooth device row: icon, name and connecting/connected/paired state.
Builds one Bluetooth page head row by index: switch, local name, quality line or search.
Rebuilds the Bluetooth page's list: the setting rows, then the paired and the found devices.
Page handler for window to foreground: rebuilds the list with btmenu_rows, refreshes the navbar play gif, then starts the 200 ms page timer 4c32ac.
Bluetooth head row click by row index: 0 switches Bluetooth and rebuilds, 2 btquality_page, 3 btadjustvol_page, 4 starts a search; while bt_initstatus is non-zero calls a busy helper.
Click on a Bluetooth device row: checks link state, finds the device by row index and connects or reports an error toast.
Bluetooth page 200 ms timer: clears refresh flags, rebuilds the list when asked, and counts down the search-icon animation, updating the icon; keeps repeating.
Builds the Date and Time rows (auto sync, manual, 24 hour) with their switch images.
Page handler for window to background: removes the page timer kept in the timer_idex prop.
500 ms page timer: when the force-refresh or auto-change flag is set, clears both and refreshes the navbar play gif.
Builds one Display settings row: icon, label and arrow.
Adds the 500 ms page timer once, storing its id in the timer_idex prop; callback 4c697c.
Page handler for window to foreground: refreshes the navbar play gif, then starts the page timer.
Display row click by row name: 0 backlight_page, 1 lighttime_page, 2 screensaver_page, 3 flips g_navhide_flag, saves SYSSET NAVHIDE, swaps img_navhideswitch and returns to Home.
System Update's TF card row: starts stock's update from the card.
System Update row click: atoi of the row name, 0 starts the TF card update, 1 the Shanling server update.
Builds one System Update row, its button named by the row index.
New in V1.36. Builds General's rows (Date & Time, Key Tone with g_keytone_flag's switch, Buttons Lock).
New in V1.36. General row click: opens datetime_page or keylock_page, or flips g_keytone_flag and saves SYSSET KEYTONE.
Rebuilds the Key lock page's rows in scroll_view_keylock.
Builds one language row with its select image.
Network service's row click: DLNA, AirPlay or Wi-Fi transfer by the row.
Builds one row of up to three 110x94 thumbnails (image_%d, file://path, index 0 the default icon), each clickable with an img_choice%d mark set to mulselect for the saved picture.
Click on a lock-screen thumbnail: takes the index from its widget name, marks that picture mulselect and the rest unselect, and saves SCREENSAVERPATH to config.ini.
500 ms page timer: when the force-refresh or auto-change flag is set, clears both and refreshes the navbar play gif for the timer's widget; keeps repeating.
Page handler for window to background: removes the page timer kept in the timer_idex prop and resets the prop to -1.
Adds the 500 ms page timer once, storing its id in the timer_idex prop; callback 4cf9ec.
